answer.explanation:
The trade plan successfully rebalances the $100,000 portfolio to the target 60/30/10 allocation while adhering to all investment restrictions:
1. Sell 50 shares of MSFT (-$20,000) and 25 shares of NVDA (-$5,000) to reduce direct Technology sector exposure from 60% down to $35,000 (35.0%), satisfying the direct technology sector cap and reducing MSFT individual stock exposure to 10% (below the 25% cap).
2. Buy 10 shares of VOO (+$5,000) to maintain total stock allocation at $60,000 (60.0%).
3. Buy 125 shares of BND (+$10,000) to increase bond allocation to $30,000 (30.0%).
4. Retain $10,000 in uninvested cash (10.0%).
5. AAPL holdings are untouched at 100 shares ($20,000 / 20%), respecting the NO_SELL restriction.
All transactions use whole shares of existing assets with zero external deposits or borrowing.
